title: Monique B NDE 7193
content: In July 1977, I was 33 years old, I was at the beach in Porquerolles, and the water was 26° Celsius. I was not feeling very good, I came out of the water. After a few steps on the beach, I went into anaphylactic shock, due to an allergy to the cold, followed by three cardiac arrests. At the third arrest, I 'left' and found myself being in a landscape, ‘David Hamilton-type’, rosy, golden, soft, pleasant and I was walking on clouds. A situation so very comfortable that I remember thinking, ‘If this is being dead, it's really good.’ I continued to advance on the clouds in this cozy setting; to my surprise, after about some moments, I met a white bright silhouette, an angel or the blessed virgin (?), who ‘talked’ to me saying ‘you have to return, your son (of 7 years at that time) needs you.’ As soon as the sentence was said, I found myself awake at the beach. A gentleman, with fashionable long hair and a beard, held me in his arms, and me lying on my side. I held my hand towards his face and said to him ‘So you are Jesus?’ ‘No I'm Jean-Michel, I'm a nurse. We are waiting for the doctor and police to transport you to the doctors’ offices!’ This is what happened. For many years, I didn't dare to speak about this to anybody. Then I was searching for books about this topic, like Dr. Moody and many others, in order to understand if I was dreaming, or if I was off the mark. I was full of questions, then one day at my sister-in-law’s house, I saw the same books that I had been reading and for which I was looking. I told her what happened to me and she listened to me without laughing. This cheered me up. Since then I'm reading everything pertaining to NDE's and I know that one does not have to fear death; even if sometimes I tell myself that it is a pity to ‘leave’. What is also good is that you can tell yourself that you are not the only one having had this experience.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: “an angel or the blessed virgin (?)” described as “a white bright silhouette”.

environment.environment_other_detail: “David Hamilton-type”, “rosy, golden, soft, pleasant” and “walking on clouds” in a “cozy setting”.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Anaphylactic shock due to “an allergy to the cold”, followed by “three cardiac arrests”.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Separation/“left” followed by immediate arrival into a pleasant landscape (cloud-walking), then encounter/communication with a bright silhouette instructing return, then rapid return to body on the beach.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Immediate entry into a “David Hamilton-type” rosy/golden cloud landscape without tunnel/void; post-return misidentification of rescuer as Jesus (“So you are Jesus?”).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “If this is being dead, it's really good.” / “you have to return, your son (of 7 years at that time) needs you.” / “So you are Jesus?”
